title: Glide Pearl White

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Daytona Glide Pearl White delivers one-handed chin bar actuation paired with certified dual-homologation protection, delivering flip-up versatility for city stops and sealed protection at speed. Built around a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell weighing a featherweight 1314g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~89 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: Budget modular with flip-up chin and inner sun visor.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Standard Daytona fit; generally runs true to size with a semi-spherical interior shell. May feel slightly tight on very large heads due to the fixed EPS liner density.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Daytona Glide Pearl White: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Daytona Glide Pearl White: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Daytona Glide Pearl White. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in Daytona's Modular lineup, the Glide Pearl White brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT track safety.
story:
The Daytona Glide Pearl White represents Daytona's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~89 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Modular helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Daytona Glide Pearl White delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
